score_translations: score a batch of translations using a fairseq model ensemble with SequenceScorer
compute_alignment: compute hard alignments between source and target tokens using SequenceScorer with compute_alignment enabled
extract_attention_weights: extract and average attention weights across an ensemble of models using SequenceScorer
get_positional_scores: get per-token log probabilities for target tokens using SequenceScorer generate method
strip_symbols_from_output: strip EOS and custom symbols from scored output tokens using symbols_to_strip_from_output
